name: caption-weight
title: Caption Weight
description: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.
useWhen: You want captions that follow the voice with typography alone: no color change, no box, just the active word gaining weight.
The brand leans on a single variable typeface and a weight shift is the most on-brand emphasis available.
avoidWhen: You need emphasis that reads at a glance on small vertical screens: use caption-active-pop, which adds color and scale.
The font has only one or two static weights, so the ramp will step: use caption-karaoke.
author: Remocn
